name: Mulled Wine
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Boil together in a pint of water a beaten nutmeg, two sticks of cinnamon broken up, and a table-spoonful of cloves slightly pounded
When reduced to one-half, strain the liquid into a quart of wine
Take it off as soon as it comes to a boil
Serve it up hot in a pitcher, surrounded by glass cups, and with it a plate of rusk

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil together in a pint of water a beaten nutmeg, two sticks of cinnamon broken up, and a table-spoonful of cloves slightly pounded
2. When reduced to one-half, strain the liquid into a quart of wine
3. Set it on hot coals
4. Take it off as soon as it comes to a boil
5. Sweeten it
6. Serve it up hot in a pitcher, surrounded by glass cups, and with it a plate of rusk
